caption: The drawing features a single, ornate pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is predominantly white with gold accents along the rim, the spout, the handle, and at the base. Decorative gold designs are visible near the top of the pitcher and around the neck. On the body of the pitcher, there is a detailed floral arrangement that includes flowers in various colors: pink, white, yellow, purple, and blue, with accompanying green and brown leaves. The floral decoration appears painted onto the surface, with stems and leaves spreading outward from the central cluster of blooms. The pitcher has a curved handle that arches from the mid-section to the top and a spout that curves out at the front. The body of the pitcher is bulbous, tapering toward the base, which is accentuated with vertical fluting and additional gold detailing.
title: White Glazed Porcelain Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
